data.body: Plan v3.1 finalized: 11-plan-v3.md revised with all three grounding annexes folded in (12a codebase truth both parts, 12b 2026 research, 12c OSS precedent). Material grounding corrections: I-1 narrowed to MCP-vs-library parity gap (terminal-status mirror already unified by e63c; config/env generators already exist); I-2 reframed as enforce-and-finish the existing isolation root (tests/conftest.py:487) not create one; I-3 confirmed genuinely new, baseline keyed per (kind,name) per ESLint suppressions pattern, reframed as general-entropy counter-pressure per 2026 evidence; I-4 anchored to scripts/backtest_bugfix_size.py + files-touched/context-fragmentation variables per MSR26; II-1.1 epic 3405 CLOSED so item becomes coverage verification; II-1.3 extends existing plan_review/reuse.py cache with formula-content hashing (Bazel action-digest pattern); II-1.4 dropped as done (sidecar versions stamped; balding-facial-huemul closed); II-2 append_event call sites corrected 72->29, freshness blocker confirmed unchanged; B-1 IETF Idempotency-Key + reconciliation polling; B-2 span-level citation checks + Renovate-style rate limits; B-3 fixed the plan's own wrong ADR citation (calibration = ADR 0036, not 0108); B-4 flutter-doctor registration architecture with brew doctor as the anti-pattern. Five world-moved events caught by grounding within 48h of drafting - premise re-verification rule vindicated again.
